UPDATE: Aug 28-29, 2026: My Hubby Soulmate passed away last year so I'm taking it one day at a time. Things we did together I now do alone and miss him in whatever it is. Taking our sweet cat Twiggy to the Vet is one of those things. Twiggy is okay, she was getting her vaccinations and a check up. She will be 16 years old in Dec of this year, 2026, so she is starting to show her age.  She has sore hips and is sore in the middle of her back. That combined with the vaccinations she received made her even more sore. I'm still getting to know the older Twiggy and when she wasn't her bright perky self I panicked thinking I would loose her as well, however Dr Pham took time from her schedule to explain what was happening and giving me options as to where to go from here.  She was clear and to the point, something one needs when they are upset and their feelings are hanging out all over the place! Thank you for caring. Dr Pham, and thank you Alex for giving Twiggy her meds while she "hid" under the wee stool. Thank you both for your expertise and taking care of not only Twiggy, but me as well.

Score in 2026 is still exceptional, 20 stars!

---

Where to go when your beloved family pet is ill or injured?  You're anxious and need help now. You dont want to hand them over to just anyone... Don't panic!  All of the staff at Jersey Village Animal Hospital (JVAH) are there for you with expertise, efficiency, and, best of all, respect and empathy.  They know your pet is not just an animal but a member of your family, so they will not roll their eyes at your concerns.  We have a cat 🐈 who we got in Scotland when we lived there and, of course, brought back with us to the US along with her brother.  We have been taking them to JVAH for 8 years, and JVAH are second to none.  Our Oscar passed a couple of years ago, and the folks at JVAH met his every need and our every concern. It was so hard, but they were so thoughtful. We continue to take Twiggy when it's required, and they are so good to her.  But more importantly, they are thorough.  We want to thank Dr. Daily, the technicians who assisted, and the kind front of house staff for their professionalism and sensitivity during Twiggy's recent UTI episode.  We wish you all a very happy and blessed New Year in 2024.

Thank you for the 5 stars! We’re honored to be part of your pet’s care team.

Dr. Peralta, Medical Lead

Thank you for your 5-star rating! We're happy to know you had a positive experience with us.

Dr. Peralta, Medical Lead

If I could give this place 10 stars I would.   My brother's apt was broken into while he was gone and his service dog was brutally attacked while trying to protect his home and his little sister.  We rushed here for help, and from the moment we walked in the door, the ENTIRE staff was attentive, compassionate and just overall the best.  I have rarely encountered people that genuinely treat your pet as if it was their own.  Not even knowing who I was, since I came in after my brother and his dog, they greeted me and told me they had an emergency and all hands were on deck and they would be with me shortly.  Once they realized I was with him, they escorted me to the room and even brought in a fan for us due to their air having some slight issues.  I can not express how great of an experience we were given even though this was a very, very stressful time.  The dr was very compassionate and didnt even charge us  since they couldn't treat Djano due to the time we arrived and the type of injuries he had.  They referred us to someone else and  reassured us he would be ok.  I can not thank the staff enough for all that they did.  You can tell they really love animals and its not just a job.  I will now be transferring my own dog to this facility based off the experience I had.  Thank yall so so much for your compassion.  It means the world to my brother, myself and Django.  ( Also, his younger dog that ran away in fear during the break in) was found today and reunited with us❣️. You guys really are the best!!!

Jersey Animal Hospital in Jersey Village, TX went above and beyond for my family during one of the hardest moments we’ve ever faced—saying goodbye to our beloved 13-year-old English Bulldog, Oliver. The euthanasia process is never easy, but Dr. Melcher and every single technician treated us with such compassion, patience, and genuine empathy.

Dr. Melcher took the time to explain everything, never rushed us, and honored the deep bond we had with Oliver. The technicians Zach, Evelyn and Vanessa were incredibly supportive, kind, and comforting, making sure both Oliver and our family felt cared for in every possible way. Their calm presence and understanding helped us navigate an emotionally overwhelming moment with grace and dignity.

We are forever grateful for the respect, love, and compassion shown to Oliver and to our family. Jersey Animal Hospital is truly a special place filled with people who care deeply—not just for animals, but for the families who love them. Thank you from the bottom of our hearts.

Originally, I Had My Sister Post A Review Anonymously, But I Would Like Someone From The Clinic To Reach Out To Me Regarding This Situation, So I Am Writing It Publicly. I Have Been Coming To Jersey Village Animal Hospital For Years And My Pets Have Always Received Good Care. My Cat Has Only Ever Needed Flea And Tick Prevention, But Now She Has To Be On Methimazole. We Are Almost Out Of Her Medication, So I Called To Request A Refill.During My First Call, I Was Placed On Hold, Then Another Staff Member Picked Up And Asked How She Could Help Me In A Very Unpleasant Tone. When I Explained I Needed To Refill My Cat’s Prescription, I Was Told She Was Too Busy To Fill It. I Tried To Explain That I Didn’t Need It Immediately, I Just Wanted To Confirm It Could Be Refilled, But The Call Was Disconnected.I Called Back Later And Spoke With Another Staff Member, Who Was Kind And Helpful. She Submitted The Refill And Explained It Would Likely Be Ready By Tuesday Afternoon Due To The Holiday Weekend, Which I Completely Understood.I Was Very Surprised That The First Interaction Was Dismissive And Unprofessional, Especially Since The Second Call Showed Me How Easily And Courteously The Situation Could Have Been Handled.

It's always a positive experience at JV Animal hospital.  They are caring, attentive, and take time to answer any questions.  Thank you!

I have been going to JV Animal Hospital since 2017. There have been many changes to the hospital over the years. The vets are great, but the hospital itself is poorly run.

My dog died when boarded here. JVAH doesn't know how she died, as no one was there when she died. She was found the next morning. After my children and I came to pick up our surviving dog, we got a call asking for payment for the boarding. The staff informed me they didn't ask for payment when we picked up our other dog due to the situation (of our dog dying) but I wouldn't get her ashes until they received payment for the boarding stay....where she died. When I picked up her ashes, it was very transactional. After waiting in a long line, I was handed a bag as though I had made a purchase, not that I was being handed the ashes of my beloved pet.

More recently, I made an appointment for my cat's steroid shot with a tech. When I arrived at the appointment, I was told they did not have the steroid in stock and have not had it in stock for over a week. Additionally, they were unsure when the delivery would come. WHY WOULD YOU MAKE AN APPOINTMENT for my pet if you don't have it in stock? The office should have called and RESCHEDULED instead of wasting my time. Their solution was for me to leave my cat and see if he could get a different steroid, which I did. They called me an hour later and informed me that he could not get the other steroid and I would be charged an extra $60 mini exam before my cat could get the correct steroid shot once it was delivered. They assured me they wouldn't charge me for the appointment where they did not treat my cat and completely wasted my time. I had to return to pick up my cat. The first thing the front desk did was try to find the bill to charge me. I informed them that there were no services rendered, and I would not be returning.

JVAH cares more about profits than your pet's life. Whatever has changed here, unfortunately, has been for the worse.

Wonderful and helpful staff, Technicians, and Veterinarians.  With them nearly 27 years or more. I boarded my 24 year old blind and I'll cat with them for 11 days, unexpectedly.  Came home to find him better and happier then when I had to leave. Would not have left him with anyone else.
Love my pups vet here. Very knowledgeable and caring staff

We have been with Dr. Elizabeth Ramsbacher for several years, and she is the reason we drive 45+ mins to this clinic rather than one closer to home. She is incredibly kind, patient, and shows a wonderful level of care for our pup. I can't see myself trusting anyone else with my pups health.
My dog is a very high anxiety dog.  The staff at JVAH are so kind and good with him.  He allows them to pick him up and play with him.  When he sees the facility he gets really happy.
